proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access spell-specific option restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The current granted-spell override surface can narrow DC, area, target, and duration, but it cannot narrow a granted spell to only specific built-in branches or spoken options.

notes: Authored the charge pool, attunement, held-item gate, fixed save DC, Fear cone override, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction honestly. The Command cast is currently over-broad in surface terms because the item-only word restriction is not representable.
